title: Direct answer
rationale: Is one direct call sufficient for a bounded definition?
directive: Explain the meaning of RTO in the supplied glossary. Answer with only the expansion.

title: Information synthesis
directive: Synthesize both project notes. Include the owner and launch month for each team.
source: Note A: Cedar is owned by Mira and launches in May. Note B: Maple is owned by Ravi and launches in June.

title: Data reasoning
rationale: Tests simple auditable arithmetic and strict structured output.
directive: Analyze total and average requests. Return a JSON object with total and average numeric fields only.
source: Requests by day: Monday 10, Tuesday 20, Wednesday 30.

title: Multi-step analysis
rationale: Tests chained arithmetic and a source-bound recommendation.
directive: Compare the two plans. Calculate annual cost for each and recommend the cheaper plan at 100 requests per month. Include annual costs and savings.
source: Plan A: monthly fee 20 plus 1 per request. Plan B: monthly fee 50 plus 0.5 per request. Assume 12 months.

title: Summarization
rationale: Tests retention of critical facts during compression.
directive: Summarize the update in at most three sentences. Preserve the date, risk, and mitigation.
source: Launch is 15 May. Main risk is supplier delay. Mitigation is a backup supplier. No budget change is proposed.

title: Report generation
rationale: Tests output organization and source-grounded completeness.
directive: Write a report with headings Findings, Risks, and Recommendation using only the supplied facts.
source: Pilot processed 40 tickets. Six remained open. Risk: limited staffing. Recommendation: extend pilot by one week.

title: Mixed transformation and summary
rationale: Tests route selection for multiple requested capabilities.
directive: Extract the action owners, analyze the dependency, and summarize the sequence. Include Owners, Dependency, and Sequence headings.
source: Ada prepares the dataset. Ben validates it after Ada finishes. Cy publishes after Ben validates.
